definitions.explanation: A city that served as a capital in the past. In Japan, this most commonly refers to Kyoto and Nara.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}は{日本|にほん}の{古都|こと}だ。
examples.english: Kyoto is an ancient capital of Japan.

examples.japanese: {古都|こと}を{訪|おとず}れて{歴史|れきし}を{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: I visited the ancient capital and felt the history.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}の{古都|こと}{奈良|なら}は{紅葉|こうよう}が{美|うつく}しく、{多|おお}くの{観光客|かんこうきゃく}が{訪|おとず}れる。
examples.english: The autumn leaves in the ancient capital of Nara are beautiful, attracting many tourists.

notes:
In Japan, {古都|こと} most commonly refers to {京都|きょうと} and {奈良|なら}. The word carries a sense of historical prestige and cultural richness. The 1966 Ancient Capitals Preservation Law ({古都|こと}{保存法|ほぞんほう}) designates Kyoto, Nara, and Kamakura among others as protected historic cities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{古都|こと}を{訪|おとず}れる: to visit the ancient capital
・{古都|こと}の{風情|ふぜい}: the atmosphere of an ancient capital
・{古都|こと}{巡|めぐ}り: touring ancient capitals
